purpose: Validate the existing radius-1 retrieval policy before the enriched MechET query population is searched; not a chemical-accuracy benchmark or a source of MechET evidence grades.
source_selection: All three experimentally performed transformations in the independently published Organic Syntheses procedure, not MechET model outputs.
primary_read_status: primary procedure inspected using web reader; direct HTML cache download returned HTTP 403, so no raw HTML checksum or automatic passage-checked evidence is claimed
source_mapping_origin: Explicit assistant-authored atom correspondence for independent retrieval controls only; must reconcile to each actual ORD structural reaction before use. These are not model/GT maps supplied at MechET inference.
required_independence_check: Every source reaction key must be absent from the frozen generated MechET query pool. Report overlaps; do not silently remove benchmark queries or tune controls.

variants.description: Unmodified source reaction; isotope, charge, stereo and precursor multiplicity are retained.
Renumber all maps on both sides by the same offset.

A hypothetical query replaces the aryl H at map 7 with F on both sides, outside the radius-1 reacting environments. The source remains the actual performed reaction; the modified query is NOT claimed experimentally demonstrated.
A counterfactual query replaces mapped nitrogen 2 by phosphorus on both sides. This is a different reacting functional-group environment, not a claim that the hypothetical chemistry is impossible.

reporting_limits: Source-anchored structural-policy controls are not a wet-lab validation of counterfactual substrates.
Three recorded transformations from one publication do not establish universal analogue precision or reaction-class breadth.
No synthetic control becomes Tier A/B evidence for MechET.
This manifest freezes controls, not successful test results; source reconciliation, independence, and expected retrieval must be executed and reported before claims.
